title: Vienna BioCenter PhD Program
about: Autumn 2026 call of the Vienna BioCenter PhD Program in life sciences. Applicants need a Master's or equivalent in a life sciences subject, or expect it within six months of the deadline. Both referees must submit references before the application can be finalised.
requirements: Master's or equivalent in a life sciences subject, or expected within 6 months of the application deadline
